state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors define the conflict tax as the performance a supervised model sacrifices in a target alignment dimension in exchange for higher performance on another, conflicting dimension when it must align with multiple goals at once (e.g. helpfulness vs harmlessness). They ask whether this tax falls in areas known to the weak supervisor, keeping the student within its control, or in cases unknown to the weak model, which constitutes weak-to-strong deception.
title: Conflict tax: performance sacrificed in the target dimension for a conflicting objective
